name: gumpbox-extensions
description: Open-source MCP client plugins for the gumpbox app.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter '@gumpbox/core' build && pnpm --filter '@gumpbox/skills' build && pnpm --filter './packages/**' run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter '@gumpbox/core' build && pnpm --filter '@gumpbox/skills' build && pnpm -r run typecheck
